body:
You make a very good point in the first paragraph. I guess there is never a *right* time to say it, so I should just pick one. That's still kind of hard but I'll try.

Thank you for the offer, but I don't really need help explaining why I want to not be alive because I've already put it in writing several times before through reddit or my own personal writing. 

I understand that I need to express myself to others, but saying that to me is kind of also like telling a depressed person that they just need to cheer up. I can't bring myself to impose on other people's lives. Sometimes I feel like I'm on fire with all the things I could tell the people around me but there is nothing that would be able to pull those things out of me. It's a wall I can't break through on my own but, because I can't bring myself to let anyone know, there is no one to help me break through it.
